title: Compute generalized Leibnitz numbers from their finite double sum

source.citation: Construction of a generalization of the Leibnitz numbers and their properties, arXiv:2011.13701

translation.notes: The Mathematica double sum is translated term for term with exact Noether rationals. Two bounded tables verify the paper’s beta-integral simplification, including the classical `(a,b)=(0,1)` specialization.
